title: Stages and tasks of one job
prompt: What does this program print? The 12 lesson trips come from one small file and were driven by 3 drivers. Type each printed line on its own line.
program:
spark.conf.set("spark.sql.adaptive.enabled", "false")
sc = spark.sparkContext
tracker = sc.statusTracker()

sc.setJobGroup("drivers", "trips per driver")
per_driver = trips.repartition(2).groupBy("driver_id").count()
print(len(tracker.getJobIdsForGroup("drivers")))

rows = per_driver.collect()
jobs = tracker.getJobIdsForGroup("drivers")
stages = sorted(tracker.getJobInfo(jobs[0]).stageIds)
print(len(jobs), len(stages), len(rows))
print([tracker.getStageInfo(s).numTasks for s in stages])
hints: `repartition`, `groupBy` and `count()` on grouped data are all transformations. Which line is the action?
There are two shuffles: `repartition(2)` and the grouping. Each one starts a new stage.
Tasks per stage: one for the one-file read, then one per partition each shuffle makes. This environment's shuffle partitions setting is 4.
